independent_checks.result: Original full text appends EOS; separate input token lengths mask prompt; padding and prompt labels ignored; native causal shifted CE, no temperature. Old Qwen helper is LETTER-specific and cannot be used unchanged for six tasks.

LC SID token order is sorted unique strings over unchanged four-position index. Callback constrains each SID position independently then EOS. Original tokenizer(token)[1] and separator[1:] assume LLaMA BOS and require explicit Qwen adaptation.

17 templates when all selected; beam20/return20/max_new10/early_stopping. Per-template user metrics then mean/min/max. No SID deduplication. Optional filter only lowers illegal SID scores to -1000; default false. Original OOM beam reduction must remain disabled for this task.
